purpose: convert authoritative roadmap/design candidate slices into dependency-aware, conflict-aware parallel waves while preserving roadmap importance and exposing compounding leverage
task_source_policy: candidate slices must be explicit and grounded in repository governing documents; engine never invents implementation tasks from prose
score_semantics: ordinal structural priority only; never duration, ROI, probability, readiness percent, or delivery estimate
selection_policy: P0-P4 priority remains outside and above this P5 decomposition layer
leverage breaks ties among otherwise eligible comparable roadmap slices
explicit downstream unlocks and reusable assets must be grounded in governing roadmap/design evidence
never create generic infrastructure solely to improve a leverage score
